name: handy
description: Real-time native mouse, keyboard, and coordinate-mapped screen control for LLMs.
long_description: Handy lets agents and LLMs natively control a computer's mouse and keyboard in real-time — including multi-step chained actions such as move, click, and type in a single call — while seeing the live screen annotated with mapped (x, y) coordinates and a mouse reticle. Includes an instant on/off permission toggle.

enabled.title: Enable Computer Control (On/Off)
enabled.description: Master permission toggle allowing LLMs to view the screen and control mouse and keyboard.
